editorialSummary.heading: An October week off, with three Thanksgiving dates to keep flexible
paragraphs: Glades families have a full October break in 2026: Fall Break Week runs October 12-16, with classes scheduled to resume October 19. Thanksgiving holidays follow November 23-27, but the first three dates are reserved for hurricane make-up if needed. Keep that part of the week flexible and watch for district instructions after a weather closure. Winter break is December 21-January 1, followed by a January 4 teacher workday. Students return Tuesday, January 5, giving families a continuous December 19-January 4 stretch away from regular classes.

Spring break also ends with an extra student-free Monday. The named vacation is March 22-26, 2027, and March 29 is a teacher workday, so students return March 30. Earlier in March, Chalo Nitka on March 5 is marked as a day without teachers or students. The year begins August 10 and finishes May 28, the calendar’s only marked early-release date for students. Senior families also have baccalaureate on May 16 and graduation on May 21 to plan around; ceremony times and venues should be confirmed with the school.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page 2026-2027 Glades County Schools PDF is the date source. The district’s current Calendars page links the same supplied Google Drive file under 2026-2027 School Calendar. That page separately lists employee calendars, and the shared navigation still has a previous-year calendar shortcut.
about.processing: The complete page was checked as extracted text and as a rendered image. Yellow marks school days, green no teachers/no students, red holidays, orange conditional hurricane make-up days and purple early release. March 5 Chalo Nitka is green; May 28 is the only purple student day, and December 18 remains yellow. Only November 23-25 are conditional, not all Thanksgiving holidays or any other break. Split the original November 23-27 range into the explicit make-up range, Thanksgiving Day and November 27 without duplicate attendance dates. The 210 weekdays between August 10 and May 28 minus 29 fixed and three scheduled conditional no-class weekdays reconcile to the printed 178. Quarter totals 44/39/51/44 and semesters 83/95 also agree. Named breaks stay separate from derived continuous spans and January/March teacher workdays. Open house is one occurrence with campus-specific times exactly as printed; the source does not specify a.m./p.m. for those entries. Senior ceremonies are milestones, including the Sunday baccalaureate, not extra student attendance dates or school closures. No senior last-attendance date, final report-card date or early-release clock is inferred. Pre-year staff reporting/learning, post-year teacher workdays and Memorial Day after the last student day are excluded. The 188 Day Calendar heading and 196-day employee line do not replace the explicit 178 student-day figure. The PDF prints no approval or revision date, and its stale metadata title July 2004 and creation timestamp are not publication evidence. Direct Google download timed out before and after an approved retry; the local SHA-256 is recorded without asserting remote byte identity. Previous-year hours and December 19, 2025 early-release bus notices are not transferred to this school year.

faqs.question: When does school start in Glades County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students begin Monday, August 10, 2026. The July and early-August teacher report dates are before the student year.

faqs.question: When is open house, and which times are listed for each school?
faqs.answer: Open house is Thursday, August 6, 2026. The calendar lists 5:00-7:00 for Moore Haven Elementary and West Glades School, and 6:00-8:00 for Moore Haven Middle-High School. Check your school’s notice for full arrival details.

faqs.question: When is fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall Break Week runs October 12-16, 2026. Including both weekends, the continuous time away from regular classes is October 10-18. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, October 19.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, and is the whole week off?
faqs.answer: The published Thanksgiving holidays are November 23-27, 2026. November 23-25 may be used as hurricane make-up days if needed, so those three dates require flexibility. November 26-27 are the remaining fixed holiday dates. Under the published schedule, classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: Which hurricane make-up dates are listed, and when will families know if they are needed?
faqs.answer: The three listed dates are November 23, 24 and 25, 2026. They are used only if needed. The annual calendar does not give an activation order; follow district and school announcements after any weather closure.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in January?
faqs.answer: Winter break is December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday with no students. Students return Tuesday, January 5. Including weekends and the workday, the continuous time away from regular classes is December 19-January 4.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and do students return on March 29?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 22-26, 2027. March 29 is a teacher workday with no students, so classes return Tuesday, March 30. The full student no-class stretch, including weekends, is March 20-29.

faqs.question: Is there school on Chalo Nitka day?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 5, 2027, is labeled Chalo Nitka and marked as a day with no teachers or students on the calendar.

faqs.question: Which in-year teacher workdays have no school for students?
faqs.answer: January 4 and March 29, 2027, are explicitly listed as Teacher Work Day (No Students). They extend the student time off after winter and spring breaks.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day or Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no classes on Monday, September 7, 2026, for Labor Day, or Wednesday, November 11, for Veterans Day.

faqs.question: Are Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day student holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027, and Monday, February 15, are listed as holidays with no student classes.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Friday, May 28, 2027, with early release for students. It also ends the fourth nine weeks and the second semester.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on May 28?
faqs.answer: The calendar says Early Release for Students ONLY but does not give a dismissal time. Confirm your school’s 2026-2027 release time and bus arrangements. The district Transportation Department can be reached at 863-946-3800.

faqs.question: Is December 18 an early-release day?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 calendar shows December 18 as a regular school day ending the second nine weeks and first semester. Its only marked student early-release date is May 28. Check school messages for any later change to dismissal.

faqs.question: When do progress reports go home?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 10 and November 12, 2026, and February 5 and April 23, 2027.

faqs.question: When are report cards sent home?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists October 22, 2026, January 8, 2027, and April 1, 2027. It does not give a final fourth-quarter report-card date; check your school’s end-of-year instructions.

faqs.question: When do grading periods and semesters end?
faqs.answer: The four nine-week periods end October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 28, 2027. The first semester ends December 18 and the second ends May 28. Grading-period endings do not by themselves mean students have the day off.

faqs.question: How many student days are on the 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The calendar explicitly lists 178 student days, with 83 in the first semester and 95 in the second. Its nine-week totals are 44, 39, 51 and 44 days. The student total comes from the Last day for students line, rather than the separate 188 Day Calendar heading.

faqs.question: When are baccalaureate and graduation for the senior class?
faqs.answer: Baccalaureate is Sunday, May 16, 2027, and graduation is Friday, May 21. The annual calendar gives no ceremony times or venues. Check the school’s senior announcements for those details and any separate senior attendance instructions.

faqs.question: Where can I open the official calendar and check for updates?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF button to open the district’s Google Drive calendar. On the district Calendars page, expand 2026-2027 and choose School Calendar. Check district News, Live Feed and messages from your school for revisions or hurricane make-up instructions.
